art_direction: 眼缘上拱位置偏外侧，双瞳正视，留白如宽短撇，内角圆钝。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Place the highest part of each eye's upper curve toward its outer half, producing two slightly shouldered marker shapes. Keep the inner corners blunt and rounded. Both large black pupils face forward, with broad short diagonal paper marks cut through their upper portions. Let each lower edge be one quick bowed stroke, shorter than the upper mass. Small flat iris areas flank the pupils. Preserve a close relationship between the two shapes without copying one exactly. No eyebrows or mouth.
